name: I'm The Dumbest Man Alive
look: A three-panel webcomic titled "DUMBEST FELLA". Top: a round-headed king in a crown and red cape stands on a cliff shouting "I'M THE DUMBEST MAN ALIVE" at a small blue figure. Bottom left: the blue figure speaks into an empty speech bubble. Bottom right: the king kneels, handing over his crown: "YOU'RE CLEARLY DUMBER".
use: The self-proclaimed dumbest king meets someone whose idea is even dumber. The empty bubble holds that person's foolish claim or plan, and the king surrenders his crown, conceding the title.
slots: the blue figure's empty speech bubble: the dumb statement
examples: I don't need to write it down, I'll remember it
I'll go to bed early tonight, right after one more video
describe: king on a cliff yelling that he is the dumbest man alive
comic where a king gives his crown to someone even dumber
webcomic of a crowned guy declaring himself the stupidest
little blue guy says something so dumb the king bows down
three panel comic where the king kneels and hands over his crown
origin: A webcomic by the artist SrGrafo.
